body.name: finite-table plug-in estimator
body.construction: On a positive branch, form the one joint empirical table \(\widehat p_H\) from \(n\) i.i.d. draws of \((V,S)\). If \(\widehat p_H\in\mathfrak D_H\), return \(\widehat Q_{a,H}=F_H(\widehat p_H)\), compute \(J_H(\widehat{\mathbf p}_H)\) in the fixed vectorization, form \(\widehat\Sigma_H\), and report the explicitly defined \(CI_y\) and \(CI_{\lambda}\) when their estimated variances are positive. Otherwise return \(\bot_H\), which records the first violated cell-margin or registered-denominator inequality, and report no point estimate or Wald set.
